null_distribution: Composite class of all adaptive/dependent laws with P(X_t=1 | F_{t-1}) <= 1/2 almost surely at every predictably indexed opportunity; not Model B, actor factor, iid Bernoulli, or a fitted population distribution.
optional_stopping: Valid for one nonnegative supermartingale: bounded stops by optional sampling, almost-surely finite unbounded stops by Fatou, and single-process crossings by Ville.
not_covered: selection or maximum across hypotheses, roles, families, games, or mode resets
training-estimated p0 without a certified conditional upper bound
accept, buy, recommendation, continuous-offer, censored, or aggregate events without separate proofs
myopic persuasion histories not visible to the acting buyer
smallest_remaining_mathematical_gap: No frozen evidence establishes the substantive conditional concession bound P(X_t=1 | F_{t-1}) <= 1/2 for the intended economic population.
